name: haunt
description: Stress-test an agent workflow with creature faults and load ramps, watch it in a haunted arena, and get a graded report plus a hardening spec from a reviewer agent.
author: kakoritz
highlights: Graded fault sweeps and load ramps against any workflow with a haunt.yaml
Reviewer agent turns a run log into a postmortem and a hardening spec
Arena page replays the run as a haunted scene
Runs offline against local mock servers bound to 127.0.0.1
useCases: Find the stage where your workflow double-charges, drops or repeats work, then get a spec that fixes it.
configuration: Run from a checkout of this repository: the MCP server starts with node and needs npm install done once. Nothing is installed or enabled automatically.
